note: The room plan of a storey in the building designer (BUILD-021 to BUILD-023; F-BLD-DESIGN level 2; docs/specs/domains/BUILDER.md section 2.7). Inner walls are straight, along x or z, 0.12 m thick, on a 5 cm grid, at least 0.6 m long, with at most one doorway 1.0 m wide. Rules: Tools/citysim/roomplan.py, ported to Prototype/play/builder.js (RoomPlan). Every room must be reached from the way in: the floor is laid out in 0.25 m cells and any part of it of 1 m2 or more that cannot be walked to is refused. Prices are chips (100 chips = 1 brix) per m2 of one side of a wall, by the storey's height; every price is a first guess for play-testing [ASSUMPTION].
